_instructions: Copy this file to lab-connection.json, edit every connection field, then set configuration_confirmed to true.
Use your own authorized SSH key. Never copy the owner's private key or put passwords into this package.
The default server address needs the university network or a working VPN; it is not a public Internet address.
server_repo points to an existing operator deployment. It is not your development clone. Do not edit teammates' clones.
First connect manually with OpenSSH and verify the server fingerprint with the owner. The launcher requires a known host and key authentication.
This launcher attaches an already READY car stack. It does not start or stop the car stack, camera, mapping session, or motors.
nano_host is used only by Start-DirectConsole (direct campus-LAN / hotspot connection to the Nano). It is a DHCP address: if it changes, on the server run  ssh nano hostname -I .
